notes: Settings are now PER CHARACTER. Your spell list, the types you assigned, which spells are toggled on, the module switches and all the tuning values are remembered separately for each character and follow whoever you log in as — so your wizard's instakill loadout and your cleric's heal list stop overwriting each other. The panel shows whose settings are on screen. A character you log into for the first time inherits your existing settings as its starting point, so nothing is lost in the upgrade. This also fixes multiboxing: two clients running two characters now write two different files instead of clobbering each other.
